details: Furthermore, there are concerns regarding AI-generated images of Sikh personalities and their potential to offend members of the Sikh community. explainer.lead: Sikhism and artificial intelligence concerns the use of AI for Sikh purposes, where some argue AI will improve access to Sikh teachings, philosophy, and history while skeptics doubt the accuracy of the information provided. It matters because the Akal Takht officially banned AI for Sikh purposes in late December 2025.

tiers.eli5: Some Sikhs use AI to help read and learn their scriptures, but others worry the computer may get things wrong or make disrespectful pictures.
tiers.practitioner: Sikhs commonly use AI for gurbani translation and learning, media generation, and virtual sangats. Pitfalls include simplification, commodification, and accuracy, plus offense from AI-generated images of Sikh personalities.
tiers.paperLevel: Not a formal technical concept; the documented scope is access to Sikh teachings, philosophy, and history, with concerns over simplification, commodification, and accuracy, and an official ban by the Akal Takht since late December 2025.

explainer.example: A user asks AI for a gurbani translation; the output may help learning but skeptics warn it could be inaccurate or oversimplified.
